metadata.title: Low-rank Matrix Completion using Alternating Minimization
metadata.authors: Prateek Jain, Praneeth Netrapalli, Sujay Sanghavi

nodes.name: Principal angle distance between subspaces
nodes.statement: Given $\widehat{U},\widehat{W}\in \mathbb{R}^{m\times k}$, $\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{U},\widehat{W}) \eqdef \|U_{\perp}^\dag W\|_2 = \|W_{\perp}^\dag U\|_2$, where $U,W$ are orthonormal bases of $\mathrm{Span}(\widehat{U})$ and $\mathrm{Span}(\widehat{W})$, and $U_\perp, W_\perp$ are bases of the perpendicular spaces.
nodes.statement_clean: Distance between two column subspaces measured by the largest principal angle.

nodes.name: Restricted Isometry Property (matrix RIP)
nodes.statement: A linear operator $\calA:\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}\to \mathbb{R}^d$ satisfies $k$-RIP with constant $\delta_k$ if for every $X$ with $\mathrm{rank}(X)\le k$: $(1-\delta_k)\|X\|_F^2 \le \|\calA(X)\|_2^2 \le (1+\delta_k)\|X\|_F^2$.
nodes.statement_clean: A linear measurement operator nearly preserves Frobenius norm of all low-rank matrices.

nodes.name: Incoherence of a low-rank matrix
nodes.statement: $M \in \mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ with SVD $M=U\Sigma V^\dag$ is $\mu$-incoherent if $\|u^{(i)}\|_2 \le \mu\sqrt{k}/\sqrt{m}$ for all $i\in [m]$ and $\|v^{(j)}\|_2 \le \mu\sqrt{k}/\sqrt{n}$ for all $j\in [n]$.
nodes.statement_clean: All rows of the singular-vector matrices have nearly uniform energy.

nodes.name: Low-Rank Matrix Sensing (LRMS)
nodes.statement: Find $X\in \mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ such that $\calA(X)=b$ and $\mathrm{rank}(X)\le k$, given $b=\calA(M)$ for an unknown rank-$k$ matrix $M$ and $d<mn$ linear measurements $b_i=\mathrm{tr}(A_i^\dag M)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Recover an unknown low-rank matrix from a small number of linear measurements.

nodes.name: Low-Rank Matrix Completion (LRMC)
nodes.statement: Find a rank-$k$ matrix $X$ such that $P_\Omega(X)=P_\Omega(M)$, where $\Omega \subset [m]\times [n]$ is the observed index set and $P_\Omega$ zeroes-out unobserved entries.
nodes.statement_clean: Recover a low-rank matrix from a small set of observed entries.

nodes.name: Bilinear least-squares (sensing)
nodes.statement: $\min_{U\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times k},\,V\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times k}}\ \|\calA(UV^\dag)-b\|_2^2$ — the non-convex bi-linear formulation underlying alternating minimization for matrix sensing.

nodes.name: Bilinear least-squares (completion)
nodes.statement: $\min_{U,V}\ \|P_\Omega(UV^\dag)-P_\Omega(M)\|_F^2$ — the non-convex bi-linear formulation underlying alternating minimization for matrix completion.

nodes.name: AltMinSense
nodes.statement: Alternating minimization for matrix sensing: initialize $\widehat{U}^0$ via top-$k$ SVD of $\sum_i A_i b_i$, then alternately solve least-squares for $\widehat{V}^{t+1}$ and $\widehat{U}^{t+1}$.
input: Target rank $k$ and number of iterations $T$

nodes.name: AltMinComplete
nodes.statement: Alternating minimization for matrix completion with sample partitioning and clipping; uses a fresh sub-sample $\Omega_t$ at each iteration to maintain independence.
input: Observed index set $\Omega$ and observed values $P_\Omega(M)$
Target rank $k$, incoherence parameter $\mu$, iteration count $T$

nodes.name: Stage-AltMin
nodes.statement: Stagewise variant of AltMinSense that solves a rank-$i$ problem at stage $i$ with SVP-based initialization, removing the dependence of the RIP constant on the condition number.

nodes.name: Singular Value Projection (SVP)
nodes.statement: One-step projected gradient followed by rank-$k$ truncated SVD; used to initialize each stage of Stage-AltMin and to initialize $\widehat{u}^0$ in the rank-$1$ analysis.

nodes.name: Geometric convergence of AltMinSense (sensing)
nodes.statement_latex: Let $M=U^*\Sigma^*(V^*)^\dag$ be a rank-$k$ matrix with singular values $\sigma_1^*\ge\dots\ge\sigma_k^*$ and let $\calA$ satisfy $2k$-RIP with $\delta_{2k} < (\sigma_k^*)^2/((\sigma_1^*)^2 \cdot 100k)$. Then for every $T>2\log(\|M\|_F/\epsilon)$, AltMinSense iterates satisfy $\|M-\widehat{U}^T(\widehat{V}^T)^\dag\|_F \le \epsilon$.
nodes.statement_clean: Under matrix RIP, AltMinSense recovers the true rank-k matrix to additive error epsilon in O(log(1/epsilon)) iterations.

nodes.name: Geometric subspace decay for AltMinSense
nodes.statement_latex: Under the assumptions of Theorem~\ref{thm:sensing_err}, the iterates of AltMinSense satisfy $\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{V}^{t+1},V^*) \le \tfrac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{U}^t,U^*)$ and $\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{U}^{t+1},U^*) \le \tfrac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{V}^{t+1},V^*)$.

nodes.name: Stage-AltMin recovery (sensing)
nodes.statement_latex: Let $M$ be a rank-$k$ incoherent matrix and $\calA$ satisfy $2k$-RIP with $\delta_{2k}<1/(3200k^2)$. Then Stage-AltMin's $i$-th stage iterates satisfy $\|M-\widehat{U}^T_{1:i}(\widehat{V}^T_{1:i})^\dag\|_F^2 \le \max(\epsilon, 16k(\sigma_{i+1}^*)^2)$, with $T=\Omega(\log(\|M\|_F/\epsilon))$.
assumptions: Stage-AltMin is run with inputs $\calA, b=\calA(M)$

nodes.name: AltMinComplete recovery (matrix completion)
nodes.statement_latex: Let $M=U^*\Sigma^*(V^*)^\dag\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ ($n\ge m$) be a rank-$k$ $\mu$-incoherent matrix; let each entry be observed independently with probability $p > C(\sigma_1^*/\sigma_k^*)^2 \mu^2 k^{2.5}\log n\,\log(k\|M\|_F/\epsilon)/(m\delta_{2k}^2)$ where $\delta_{2k}\le \sigma_k^*/(12k\sigma_1^*)$. Then for $T=C'\log(\|M\|_F/\epsilon)$, w.h.p. AltMinComplete returns $\|M-\widehat{U}^T(V^T)^\dag\|_F \le \epsilon$.
assumptions: Each entry of $M$ is observed i.i.d. with probability $p$ as above with $\delta_{2k}\le\sigma_k^*/(12k\sigma_1^*)$

nodes.name: Geometric subspace decay for AltMinComplete
nodes.statement_latex: Under the assumptions of Theorem~\ref{thm:sampling-altmin-main}, w.h.p. for all $1\le t\le T$: $\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{V}^{t+1},V^*) \le \tfrac{1}{4}\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{U}^t,U^*)$ and $\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{U}^{t+1},U^*) \le \tfrac{1}{4}\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{V}^{t+1},V^*)$.

nodes.name: Noisy AltMinSense recovery
nodes.statement_latex: Under assumptions of Theorem~\ref{thm:sensing_err}, with $b=\calA(M+N)$ and $\|N\|_F<\sigma_k^*/100$, for $T=4\log(2/\epsilon)$: $\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{V}^T,V^*)\le 10\|N\|_F/\sigma_k^*+\epsilon$ and $\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{U}^T,U^*)\le 10\|N\|_F/\sigma_k^*+\epsilon$.
assumptions: Same as Theorem TP443.1 plus noise matrix $N$ with $\|N\|_F<\sigma_k^*/100$

nodes.name: Rank-1 sensing error bound
nodes.statement_latex: Let $\calA$ satisfy $2$-RIP with constant $\delta_2$. Then $\|B^{-1}(\langle u^*,u^t\rangle B - C)v^*\| \le \frac{3\delta_2}{1-3\delta_2}\sqrt{1-\langle u^t,u^*\rangle^2}$.

nodes.name: QR-irrelevance lemma
nodes.statement_latex: If $\widehat{U}^t$ (AltMinSense iterate) and $\widetilde{U}^t$ (modified version with explicit QR) are full-rank and span the same subspace, then so are $\widehat{V}^{t+1},\widetilde{V}^{t+1}$ and $\widehat{U}^{t+1},\widetilde{U}^{t+1}$, with $\mathrm{Span}(\widehat{V}^{t+1})=\mathrm{Span}(\widetilde{V}^{t+1})$.
assumptions: $\widehat{U}^t,\widetilde{U}^t$ are both full-rank and span the same subspace

nodes.name: Power-method form of AltMinSense update
nodes.statement_latex: $\widehat{V}^{t+1} = V^*\Sigma^*(U^*)^\dag U^t - F$ and $V^{t+1}=\widehat{V}^{t+1}(R^{(t+1)})^{-1}$, where $F$ is the error matrix defined via $B^{-1}(BD-C)Sv^*$ and $R^{(t+1)}$ comes from QR-decomposition of $\widehat{V}^{t+1}$.
assumptions: $\widehat{U}^t$ is the $t$-th step iterate of AltMinSense and $V^t,\widehat{V}^{t+1}$ are obtained by Update (eq:update_k1)

nodes.name: Bound on error matrix norm $\|F(\Sigma^*)^{-1}\|_2$ (sensing)
nodes.statement_latex: $\|F(\Sigma^*)^{-1}\|_2 \le \frac{\delta_{2k}\,k}{1-\delta_{2k}}\,\mathrm{dist}(U^t,U^*)$.

nodes.name: Bound on $\|\Sigma^*(R^{(t+1)})^{-1}\|_2$ (sensing)
nodes.statement_latex: $\|\Sigma^*(R^{(t+1)})^{-1}\|_2 \le (\sigma_1^*/\sigma_k^*)/(\sqrt{1-\mathrm{dist}^2(U^t,U^*)} - (\sigma_1^*/\sigma_k^*)\delta_{2k}k\,\mathrm{dist}(U^t,U^*)/(1-\delta_{2k}))$.

nodes.name: Rank-1 completion error bound
nodes.statement_latex: Let $u^t$ be a unit vector with incoherence $\mu_1=6(1+\delta_2)\mu/(1-\delta_2)$. Then w.p. $\ge 1-1/n^3$: $\|B^{-1}(\langle u^*,u^t\rangle B-C)v^*\|_2 \le \frac{\delta_2}{1-\delta_2}\sqrt{1-\langle u^t,u^*\rangle^2}$.
assumptions: $u^t$ is a unit vector with incoherence parameter $\mu_1=6(1+\delta_2)\mu/(1-\delta_2)$

nodes.name: Incoherence preservation of $v^t$ (rank-1)
nodes.statement_latex: If $u^t$ is a unit vector with incoherence parameter $\mu_1=6(1+\delta_2)\mu/(1-\delta_2)$, then w.p. $\ge 1-1/n^3$, the next iterate $v^t$ is also $\mu_1$-incoherent.

nodes.name: SVD + clipping joint guarantee for $U^0$
nodes.statement_latex: Let $M,\Omega,p$ be as in Theorem~\ref{thm:sampling-altmin-main} and let $U^0$ be obtained by step 4 of AltMinComplete. Then w.h.p.: (i) $\mathrm{dist}(U^0,U^*) \le 1/2$ and (ii) $U^0$ is incoherent with parameter $4\mu\sqrt{k}$.
assumptions: $U^0$ is the initial iterate of AltMinComplete after the SVD + clipping step

nodes.name: Incoherence preservation of $V^t$ (rank-k completion)
nodes.statement_latex: If $U^t$ is $\mu_1=16\sigma_1^*\mu\sqrt{k}/\sigma_k^*$-incoherent, then w.p. $\ge 1-1/n^3$, $V^{t+1}$ is also $\mu_1$-incoherent.

nodes.name: Bound on $\|F(\Sigma^*)^{-1}\|_2$ (completion)
nodes.statement_latex: If $U^t$ is $\mu_1$-incoherent then w.p. $\ge 1-1/n^3$: $\|F(\Sigma^*)^{-1}\|_2 \le \frac{\delta_{2k}k}{1-\delta_{2k}}\mathrm{dist}(U^t,U^*)$.
assumptions: $U^t$ is $\mu_1$-incoherent orthonormal matrix obtained after $(t-1)$-th update

nodes.name: Bound on $\|\Sigma^*(R^{(t+1)})^{-1}\|_2$ (completion)
nodes.statement_latex: Under assumptions of Theorem TP443.4 and incoherence of $U^t$: $\|\Sigma^*(R^{(t+1)})^{-1}\|_2 \le (\sigma_1^*/\sigma_k^*)/(\sqrt{1-\mathrm{dist}^2(U^t,U^*)}-(\sigma_1^*/\sigma_k^*)\delta_{2k}k\mathrm{dist}(U^t,U^*)/(1-\delta_{2k}))$.

nodes.name: Stage-AltMin SVP-init error bound
nodes.statement_latex: Let assumptions of Theorem TP443.3 hold and let $\widehat{U}^0_{1:i},\widehat{V}^0_{1:i}$ be the SVP-initialized iterate at stage $i$. If $\|M-\widehat{U}^T_{1:i-1}\widehat{V}^T_{1:i-1}\|_F^2\le 16k(\sigma_i^*)^2$, then $\|M-\widehat{U}^0_{1:i}(\widehat{V}^0_{1:i})^\dag\|_F^2 \le \sum_{j=i+1}^k(\sigma_j^*)^2 + (\sigma_i^*)^2/100$.

nodes.name: Stage-AltMin AltMin error bound
nodes.statement_latex: Under the assumptions of Theorem TP443.3, if $\|M-\widehat{U}^0_{1:i}V^0_{1:i}\|_F^2 \le \sum_{j=i+1}^k(\sigma_j^*)^2+(\sigma_i^*)^2/100$, then $\|M-\widehat{U}^T_{1:i}(\widehat{V}^T_{1:i})^\dag\|_F^2 \le \max(\epsilon, 16k(\sigma_{i+1}^*)^2)$ for $T=\Omega(\log(\|M\|_F/\epsilon))$.

nodes.name: RIP-implied inner-product preservation
nodes.statement_latex: If $\calA$ satisfies $2k$-RIP with constant $\delta_{2k}$ then for any $U_1,U_2\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times k}$, $V_1,V_2\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times k}$: $|\langle \calA(U_1V_1^\dag),\calA(U_2V_2^\dag)\rangle - \mathrm{Tr}(U_2^\dag U_1V_1^\dag V_2)| \le 3\delta_{2k}\|U_1V_1^\dag\|_F\|U_2V_2^\dag\|_F$.

nodes.name: Min singular value of $B$ (sensing)
nodes.statement_latex: If $\calA$ satisfies $2k$-RIP, then the block matrix $B$ defined in (eq:BCD_k) satisfies $\sigma_{\min}(B) \ge 1-\delta_{2k}$.

nodes.name: SVP one-step bound (cited)
nodes.statement_latex: Let $b=\calA(M)+e$ with $\calA$ a $2k$-RIP operator ($\delta_{2k}<1/3$) and $X^{t+1}$ the $(t+1)$-th SVP iterate. Then $\|\calA(X^{t+1})-b\|_2^2 \le \|\calA(M)-b\|_2^2 + 2\delta_{2k}\|\calA(X^t)-b\|_2^2$.

nodes.name: Bernstein's inequality
nodes.statement_latex: For independent random variables $X_1,\dots,X_n$ with $|X_i|\le L$: $\mathbb{P}(|\sum_i X_i - \sum_i \mathbb{E}[X_i]| > t) \le 2\exp(-(t^2/2)/(\sum_i \mathrm{Var}(X_i) + Lt/3))$.

nodes.name: First-step SVD bound (Keshavan-Montanari-Oh)
nodes.statement_latex: If $M$ is rank-$k$ incoherent and $p,\Omega$ as in Theorem TP443.4, and $M_k$ is the best rank-$k$ approximation of $\frac{1}{p}P_\Omega(M)$, then w.h.p. $\|M-M_k\|_2 \le C\sqrt{k/(p\sqrt{mn})}\,\|M\|_F$.
assumptions: $M_k$ is the best rank-$k$ approximation of $\frac{1}{p}P_\Omega(M)$

nodes.name: Rank-1 sensing power-method decomposition
nodes.statement_latex: $\|\widehat{u}^t\|_2\,\widehat{v}^{t+1} = \underbrace{\langle u^*,u^t\rangle\,\sigma^*\,v^*}_{\text{Power Method}} - \underbrace{B^{-1}(\langle u^*,u^t\rangle B - C)\sigma^* v^*}_{\text{Error Term}}$.

nodes.name: Definition of $B,C$ (rank-1 sensing)
nodes.statement_latex: $B=\sum_{i=1}^d A_i u^t (u^t)^\dag A_i^\dag$ and $C=\sum_{i=1}^d A_i u^t (u^*)^\dag A_i^\dag$.

nodes.name: Rank-1 completion power-method decomposition
nodes.statement_latex: $\|\widehat{u}^t\|_2\,\widehat{v}^{t+1} = \underbrace{\langle u^*,u^t\rangle\,\sigma^*\,v^*}_{\text{Power Method}} - \underbrace{\sigma^* B^{-1}(\langle u^t,u^*\rangle B - C)\,v^*}_{\text{Error Term}}$, with diagonal $B_{jj} = \sum_{i:(i,j)\in\Omega}(u_i^t)^2/p$ and $C_{jj} = \sum_{i:(i,j)\in\Omega} u_i^t u_i^* /p$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP443.1 (sensing recovery)
nodes.statement: Reduce $\|M-\widehat{U}^T(\widehat{V}^T)^\dag\|_F^2$ via RIP and the least-squares optimality of $\widehat{U}^T$ to $\|M\|_F^2 \mathrm{dist}^2(V^T,V^*)$, then apply Theorem TP443.2.

nodes.name: RIP reduction of Frobenius error
nodes.statement_latex: $\|M-\widehat{U}^T(\widehat{V}^T)^\dag\|_F^2 \le \frac{1}{1-\delta_{2k}}\|\calA(M-\widehat{U}^T(\widehat{V}^T)^\dag)\|_2^2$ by RIP ($\zeta_1$).

nodes.name: Use least-squares optimality of $\widehat{U}^T$
nodes.statement_latex: $\|\calA(M-\widehat{U}^T(\widehat{V}^T)^\dag)\|_2^2 \le \|\calA(M(I-V^T(V^T)^\dag))\|_2^2$ since $\widehat{U}^T$ is the least-squares solution ($\zeta_2$).

nodes.name: Reapply RIP and bound by subspace distance
nodes.statement_latex: Combine ($\zeta_3,\zeta_4$) to obtain $\|M-\widehat{U}^T(\widehat{V}^T)^\dag\|_F^2 \le \frac{1+\delta_{2k}}{1-\delta_{2k}}\|M\|_F^2 \mathrm{dist}^2(V^T,V^*)$.

nodes.name: Conclude via Theorem TP443.2
nodes.statement_latex: Theorem TP443.2 gives $\mathrm{dist}^2(V^T,V^*)$ decays geometrically; choose $T$ large enough so the RHS is $\le \epsilon$ ($\zeta_5$).

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP443.2 (rank-k subspace decay)
nodes.statement: Decompose $\widehat{V}^{t+1}$ as power-method update + error $F$ (Lemma LP443.3); bound $\|F(\Sigma^*)^{-1}\|_2$ (Lemma LP443.4) and $\|\Sigma^*(R^{(t+1)})^{-1}\|_2$ (Lemma LP443.5); combine and use SVP initialization to get $\mathrm{dist}(U^0,U^*)<1/2$.

nodes.name: Express $\widehat{V}^{t+1}$ as power-method + error
nodes.statement_latex: By Lemma LP443.3, $\widehat{V}^{t+1}=V^*\Sigma^*(U^*)^\dag U^t - F$.

nodes.name: Apply Lemmas LP443.4 and LP443.5
nodes.statement_latex: Combine the two spectral-norm bounds to get $\mathrm{dist}(V^{t+1},V^*) \le (\sigma_1^*/\sigma_k^*)\delta_{2k}k\,\mathrm{dist}(U^t,U^*)/((1-\delta_{2k})L)$.

nodes.name: Initialize $U^0$ via SVP and bound $\mathrm{dist}(U^0,U^*)$
nodes.statement_latex: By Lemma LP443.16, $\mathrm{dist}(U^0,U^*) \le \sqrt{6\delta_{2k}k}(\sigma_1^*/\sigma_k^*) < 1/2$.

nodes.name: Conclude $1/4$ contraction for $V$ and $U$
nodes.statement_latex: With $\delta_{2k}<1/(24(\sigma_1^*/\sigma_k^*)^2 k)$ obtain $\mathrm{dist}(V^t,V^*)<\tfrac{1}{4}\mathrm{dist}(U^t,U^*)$ and similarly for $U^{t+1}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP443.5 (rank-k completion subspace decay)
nodes.statement: Same skeleton as PP443.2: decompose update via Lemma LP443.3, bound $\|F(\Sigma^*)^{-1}\|_2$ via Lemma LP443.10 and $\|\Sigma^*(R^{(t+1)})^{-1}\|_2$ via Lemma LP443.11, use Lemma LP443.8 ($\mathrm{dist}(U^0,U^*)\le 1/2$) and Lemma LP443.9 (incoherence) to close the induction.

nodes.name: Update equation and projection
nodes.statement_latex: Derive $\mathrm{dist}(V^*,V^{t+1}) \le \|F(\Sigma^*)^{-1}\|_2 \|\Sigma^*(R^{(t+1)})^{-1}\|_2$ from $\widehat{V}^{t+1}=V^*\Sigma^*(U^*)^\dag U^t-F$.

nodes.name: Apply completion lemmas LP443.10 and LP443.11
nodes.statement_latex: Plug bounds: $\mathrm{dist}(V^*,V^{t+1}) \le (\sigma_1^*/\sigma_k^*)k(\delta_{2k}/(1-\delta_{2k}))\mathrm{dist}(U^t,U^*)/L$.

nodes.name: Use incoherence preservation and base case
nodes.statement_latex: Lemma LP443.8 gives $\mathrm{dist}(U^t,U^*) \le 1/2$ and Lemma LP443.9 gives $V^t$ incoherence; choose $\delta_{2k}<\sigma_k^*/(12k\sigma_1^*)$ to obtain $\tfrac{1}{4}$ contraction.

nodes.name: Conclude geometric decay
nodes.statement_latex: $\mathrm{dist}(V^{t+1},V^*) \le \tfrac{1}{4}\mathrm{dist}(U^t,U^*)$ and $\mathrm{dist}(U^{t+1},U^*) \le \tfrac{1}{4}\mathrm{dist}(V^{t+1},V^*)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP443.3 (Stage-AltMin recovery)
nodes.statement: Induction on stage $i$: base case at $i=0$ has error $\le k(\sigma_1^*)^2$; inductive step combines Lemma LP443.12 (SVP-init bound) and Lemma LP443.13 (AltMin reduction) so $i$-th stage achieves $\max(\epsilon, 16k(\sigma_{i+1}^*)^2)$.

nodes.name: Base case
nodes.statement_latex: After 0-th step, error $\|M\|_F^2 \le \sum_j(\sigma_j^*)^2 \le k(\sigma_1^*)^2$.

nodes.name: Inductive step: SVP initialization (Lemma LP443.12)
nodes.statement_latex: Apply Lemma LP443.12 to bound $\|M-\widehat{U}^0_{1:i}(\widehat{V}^0_{1:i})^\dag\|_F^2$ at the start of stage $i$.

nodes.name: Inductive step: AltMin error reduction (Lemma LP443.13)
nodes.statement_latex: Apply Lemma LP443.13 to obtain $\|M-\widehat{U}^T_{1:i}(\widehat{V}^T_{1:i})^\dag\|_F^2 \le \max(\epsilon, 16k(\sigma_{i+1}^*)^2)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP443.5 rank-1 case (matrix completion)
nodes.statement: Three-step plan: base case (Lemma LP443.8 gives incoherent close $u^0$); induction step on distance using Lemma LP443.6 to bound the error term; induction step on incoherence via Lemma LP443.7.

nodes.name: Base case via Lemma LP443.8
nodes.statement_latex: $u^0$ is incoherent and $\langle u^0,u^*\rangle \ge 6\delta_2$ for $\delta_2\le 1/12$.

nodes.name: Induction step on distance
nodes.statement_latex: Multiplying (eq:compvtupdate) with $v^*$ and $v_\perp$ and using Lemma LP443.6 yields $\mathrm{dist}(v^t,v^*) \le \tfrac{1}{4}\sqrt{1-\langle u^t,u^*\rangle^2}$.

nodes.name: Induction step on incoherence
nodes.statement_latex: Lemma LP443.7 gives that $v^t$ is also $\mu_1$-incoherent, closing the induction.

nodes.name: Properties of subspace distance
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{dist}(\widehat{U},\widehat{W})$ depends only on column spans, equals $1$ when ranks differ, and equals $0$ iff the subspaces coincide.

nodes.name: AltMin as perturbed power method
nodes.statement: Once RIP holds, AltMinSense iterates can be analyzed as a perturbed power-method update: $\widehat{V}^{t+1} = (\text{power update}) - F$ with bounded error $F$.

nodes.name: Sample-splitting for AltMinComplete
nodes.statement: AltMinComplete partitions $\Omega$ into $2T+1$ disjoint subsets, one per iteration, so that each new sub-sample is independent of the current iterate; this is essential for the incoherence argument.

nodes.name: Comparison with trace-norm methods
nodes.statement: AltMinSense converges in $O(\log(1/\epsilon))$ iterations vs. $O(1/\sqrt{\epsilon})$ for first-order trace-norm methods, and avoids per-step SVDs of $m\times n$ matrices required by interior-point or projected-gradient methods.
